condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: EAP COs have received RO technical support in various areas. They included e.g.: access to quality ECE services and advocacy; Southeast Asia Primary Learning Metrics (SEAPLM) and strengthening national learning assessment systems; foundational literacy and numeracy for the most marginalized; disability-inclusive education; multilingual education; digital learning; climate smart education; disaster risk reduction and education in emergencies preparedness and capacity building; safe to learn and mental health and psychosocial support; gender equality and girls’ education; school-related gender-based violence. EAP COs have also received RO support for resource mobilization and partnership management, including partnerships including Global Partnership for Education (GPE).
